The Origins: A Joke Worth Billions
It all started in 2013 with Dogecoin. Created as a joke by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer, Dogecoin combined the viral Shiba Inu “Doge” meme with Bitcoin’s blockchain technology. Its purpose? To poke fun at the growing crypto mania.
